data.name: CORDURA
data.detailed_description:
Quota Co-Op Survival Horror Evolves the "Friendslop" Formula with Premium AA Quality & Mimic System.

CORDURA is a co-op psychological horror game where coordination is the only way to survive the stalking darkness that mimics your team. Communicate using proximity voice chat, but be careful: The Night listens to every word and noisy step. Face unpredictable procedural maps, collecting the Roses of the Night, and escape before paranoia turns your allies into your worst nightmare.

CORDURA offers a co-op experience for up to 4 players where team coordination is the key to survival. Venture into the dark together to mine the Roses of the Night, track threats using the control desk, and coordinate to avoid certain death.  In the darkness, no one is safe.

Fewer than 4 players? No problem: the dynamic difficulty system automatically scales the maps and the threat of The Night, ensuring a balanced challenge and an atmosphere of constant horror whether you play solo or with friends.

"It's a simple job, for men with nerve"

Science once dared to blur the boundaries of the Night, and now the darkness has returned to reclaim its own. Victorian buildings awaken corrupted by a primal influence, twisting their halls into procedural labyrinths and reducing inhabitants to empty shells that now stalk from the shadows.

Yet, desire proves stronger than fear. Deep within these walls grows the Rose of the Night, the source of the Ambrosia. A potent neurostimulant coveted by the aristocracy for their decadent gatherings. You will take on the role of the workers who enter to extract this prize before you lose your sanity.

Few return alive, but greed always finds new volunteers.

  • 4-Player Co-op Expeditions: Venture into the dark together. Manage your risks, make every effort to remain unseen, and communicate to escape the labyrinth.  In these places, silence keeps you hidden—but only communication will get you out.

  • Mimic System & Verbal Deception: The Night hears you and calls you by name. Proximity voice chat becomes a double-edged sword: the darkness can mimic the voice and appearance of your allies to lure you into the abyss.

  • Sanity & The Companion Bond: As the night darkens, your sanity shatters. The only way to restore it is to physically reunite with a teammate. But a lingering doubt remains: has your ally truly arrived in time, or is the Night wearing their face to finish you off?

  • Permadeath & Character Customization: Recruit your workers and customize them exactly how you want—but watch your step. A single misstep means permanent death. Don't worry, though; a new recruit is always ready to take their place.

  • Evolving Procedural Labyrinths: Two incursions are never the same. The mansion reshapes its halls in real-time, forcing you to mark the walls to keep your bearings. Do not rely blindly on external guidance; creeping corruption can make familiar routes vanish in seconds.

data.short_description: Cordura is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. While one player guides the team, the others explore shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths. Lose your sanity and the night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Escape and survive.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Turkish, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7300HQ equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700HQ equivalent or greater
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1670 equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
